title: THE GOSPEL NET

blocks.text: “What an era and dispensation of time to be living in, the very hour that the kingdom of God is fulfilling its course and the Lord is personally gathering His true seed! – Also on the other hand prophecy is taking place worldwide, startling and amazing events are occurring in every nation as it has been predicted in the scrolls and books we have printed! Also so much has happened it is impossible to relate them all at one time!” Truly the Lord’s coming is drawing nigh and the Holy Spirit would have me now write this Scripture here concerning the parable of “the net”, Matt. 13:47-50, “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and set down, and gathered the good into vessels, and cast the bad away!” “And it goes on to say at the end the angels shall come forth and sever the wicked from among the just, and shall cast them into the furnace of fire!” And a new manifestation is occurring, the gospel net of the Holy Spirit is ready to be pulled in because the separation is here! Men help put the gospel net out but now the angels separate the good seed from the bad seed of fishes! It is like the wheat being separated from the tares!

“The Bible says no man putteth a new garment on the old, the old garment speaks of the old religions that have backslid into systems, and from time to time been patched up! But now God is giving a new garment clothed in righteous light to His elect, and it will not be used to patch up the old religious natures (organizations.) – And this new garment will fold into the wedding garment that we will receive!” (Rev. 19:8) – “Remember St. Matt. 22:11-13, one guest appeared at the wedding and did not have the right garment on, and he was cast out! He still had on the old nature garment of religious systems and was rejected!” The Bride is pure and will come into His light and will not be associated with Babylon! “Also this new wine of the spirit He has given us, if it were put into the old bottles, it would burst them all to pieces! (Matt. 9:16-17) But it will fit in the vessels that God has made new by His spirit.” Amen! I feel compelled by the spirit again to put this Scripture here concerning you and my partners! Isa. 45:3, 8, “And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, (Revelation mystery) and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel!” And he continues, “drop down, ye heavens from above and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord hath created it!” Verse 11, “Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of My hands, command ye Me!” The Lord is willing to reveal and work quickly to unite His “headsons” (first fruits!) – And we know the Lord literally opened up His heavens here and poured out His blessings upon us! “According to the supernatural way in which God is using the ministry I will probably be the most misunderstood messenger who came in this generation. But this is also because God is doing it strictly His way and His plans and not according to man’s religious ideas, and no matter what message has been given through other men this one is God’s own choice, and not mine!” “Thus saith the Lord Jesus I have chosen this path and have called those who are to walk there in it; these will be those who follow Me wheresoever I goeth!”
